# libjxl / fuzz_iccprofile_transform

libjxl's own fuzz target `fuzz_iccprofile_transform` ([source](source/fuzz_iccprofile_transform.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over libjxl (libjxl/libjxl at aea3a06e).

skcms_Parse of the input profile, then skcms_Transform of a fixed 64-pixel RGBA ramp sRGB->profile and profile->sRGB for all alpha formats, before and after skcms_MakeUsableAsDestination; transformed pixels and return values ignored (no round-trip comparison).

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against libjxl at commit aea3a06e.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- The embedded constant sRGB profile must parse (exit(1) otherwise) -- independent of the input, so trivially true once it passes once ([lines 71-75](source/fuzz_iccprofile_transform.c#L71-L75)): exit(1); not confirmed in the binary.
